card.text: One of the two nearest brown dwarfs, its clouds mapped from the Doppler shifts of its spectrum as it spins.

sources.label: Ureshino et al. 2026
sources.quote: Our analysis reveals a large-scale dark region at mid-latitudes

introduction.text: Luhman 16 B is a brown dwarf 2 parsecs away that circles its companion A every 27 years. Doppler imaging finds a large dark patch and brighter spots.

sources.label: Ureshino et al. 2026
sources.quote: Our analysis reveals a large-scale dark region at mid-latitudes, consistent with previous studies

color.title: Colour
color.summary: The colour of its measured optical spectrum: magenta, because sodium and potassium absorb the yellow and green.

brightness.title: Surface brightness
brightness.summary: Brighter and darker cloud patches, mapped from how the spectrum shifts as it spins.

uncertainty.title: Brightness uncertainty
uncertainty.summary: How far the brightness map could be off at each point.
